verdict.rationale: WezTerm's automations live in a plain Lua config file (`.wezterm.lua`, `wezterm.on` callbacks) that auto-reloads, but the evidence shows no product feature for versioning, reviewing, or rolling back those automations. Community reports of diffing and syncing the config with chezmoi or nix are user-side workarounds with external tools, so they earn no credit. Hot-reload and command-line overrides are adjacent features, not version history or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
